specification.name: NCTD Manifest Parser
specification.description: Machine-readable rules for parsing NCTD manifests into TOBI-compatible Output and Invalid Trips CSV files. v2.0.0 = v1.4.0 plus the changes of NCTD_Manifest_Parser_Rules_v2.0.json (identifiers, companions, tags and collisions); anything v2.0 does not mention is kept from v1.4.0.

changes: Identifiers (ID-POLICY-001): Vendor ID and Leg ID are strictly alphanumeric and deterministic: {AlnumClientID}{YYYYMMDD}{HHMM}[PCA][A|B]. Journey ID, its daily sequence and the 72-hour fingerprint registry are removed.
Output columns: Journey ID removed; Vendor ID and Pair Status added (32 columns).

Companions (PCA, COM, COMP): Tobi MRN {AlnumClientID}PCA, First Name + " - PCA", Last Name + " COMPANION", each exactly once. Companions are paired among themselves; a companion without a client is no longer an error.

Pairing (PAIRING-001): group by AlnumClientID, effective trip date and companion status; reciprocal addresses; earlier pickup = A, later = B; unpaired = A with Pair Status Unpaired; paired rows get Pair Status Paired.
Collisions: VENDOR_ID_COLLISION, LEG_ID_COLLISION and AMBIGUOUS_PAIRING block the export of the Output file.
Rows with an empty or invalid required field still go to Invalid Trips and do not block the export; a missing identifier component is reported as MISSING_ID_COMPONENT.

Tags: values Cannot Be Left Alone and Visually Impaired; phrases are the union of v1.4.0 and v2.0 (adds CBLA and CAN NOT BE LEFT ALONE); sources Comments, Assisted, PickUpLocationName and DropLocationName.
Pair Status value for reciprocal pairs set to Paired (v2.0 only defines Unpaired).
Superseded: Leg_ID_A/Leg_ID_B (rules document v1.3 of 2026-11-10), Journey ID, ASSISTANT_WITHOUT_CLIENT, MULTIPLE_CLIENTS_SAME_LEG and the other journey exceptions.
Added file_contract.output_file_naming: names of the Output, Invalid Trips and updated Pasajeros files.
When the trip date is changed, the new date appears in the Output and Invalid Trips file names.
Added acceptance tests AT-18 to AT-20.
Added trip_date_override: optional replacement of TripDate before processing.
Journey ID and Leg ID use the effective trip date, so they change when the trip date is changed.
Added trip_date_constraints: one TripDate per Source file; pickup and dropoff on the same day.
Added exception UNKNOWN_PASSENGER_TYPE (error) for Passenger Ty values outside passenger_types.
Added acceptance tests AT-14 to AT-17.
Confirmed: Pickup Gate Code drops the leading # (GATE CODE #7444 -> 7444).
Confirmed: rows with an unknown Passenger Ty go to Invalid Trips with UNKNOWN_PASSENGER_TYPE.
Previous baseline.

kept_from_v1_4_0: Trip Purpose mapping and default Appointment

output_file_naming.source_base_name: Source file name without its extension.

when_trip_date_changed.rule: If the Source base name contains the original trip date in a recognized format, replace it with the new date written in the same format. Otherwise append an underscore and the new date in the fallback format to the Source base name, before the suffix.
when_trip_date_changed.date_token_boundaries: The date must not be preceded or followed by a digit.

export_gate.export_ready_when: no blocking exception (VENDOR_ID_COLLISION, LEG_ID_COLLISION, AMBIGUOUS_PAIRING, INVALID_VENDOR_ID, INVALID_LEG_ID)
export_gate.when_blocked: The Output file is not produced; Invalid Trips, the updated Pasajeros file and the summary are still available so the source can be corrected.

trip_date_constraints.description: Every valid row in a Source file shares one TripDate. NCTD trips always start and end on the same day, so Pickup Time and Dropoff Time use the same date and never cross midnight.

multiple_dates_action.effect: Block trip_date_override and report the distinct dates found.

missing_id_component.action: route the row to invalid_trips; does not block the export (decision 2026-11-10)
missing_id_component.also_when: Client ID has no letters or digits after id_component_cleanup

trip_date_override.trigger: User enables the change-date option and selects a new date.
trip_date_override.effective_trip_date: The new date when the override is applied; otherwise the original normalized TripDate.
trip_date_override.apply_to: every Source row whose original TripDate is valid
trip_date_override.rows_with_missing_or_invalid_TripDate: Leave unchanged; they are routed to invalid_trips by required_field_validation.
trip_date_override.invalid_trips_output: Write the original Source row values, including the original TripDate.

affected_destination_fields.Dropoff Time: effective trip date + DOAppt; empty when DOAppt is empty
affected_destination_fields.Vendor ID: YYYYMMDD from the effective trip date
affected_destination_fields.Leg ID: YYYYMMDD from the effective trip date

trip_date_override.identifier_rule: Vendor ID, Leg ID and pairing use the effective trip date, never the original TripDate, when an override is applied.

normalization.id_component_cleanup: Remove every character outside A-Z, a-z, and 0-9 from each component before concatenation.

exact_duplicate_rule.definition: Every normalized Source column is identical.
exact_duplicate_rule.action: retain first and remove later exact copies

passenger_types_unknown.description: Rows whose Passenger Ty is not CLI, PCA, COM or COMP get no Journey ID or Leg ID and are written to Invalid Trips with Validation Status EXCEPTION.

id_policy.on_missing_component: ROUTE_TO_INVALID_TRIPS (MISSING_ID_COMPONENT); does not block the export (decision 2026-11-10)

client_name.no_comma: keep the full value in Last Name

tobi_mrn.idempotency: For companions, a trailing PCA (or legacy _PCA / -PCA) in Client ID is removed before adding PCA, so PCA is never duplicated.

booking_fare.rule: If parsed numeric value is greater than 0 use it; otherwise use 0.

phones.valid_phone: 10-digit US number; allow common separators, parentheses, labels, spacing, optional country code 1

tobi_tags.phrase_policy: Union of v1.4.0 and v2.0 phrases (decision 2026-11-10).
tobi_tags.order: Cannot Be Left Alone before Visually Impaired

pairing.primary_match: Pickup street, suite, city and ZIP of one row equal the dropoff street, suite, city and ZIP of the other row, and vice versa (no fuzzy matching).
pairing.assignment: Within each reciprocal pair, earlier PUTime is A and later PUTime is B. The order of source rows does not matter.
pairing.candidate_window: A return is a candidate for an outbound row when it starts later and no other row with the outbound route starts in between; the same applies in reverse. This keeps two round trips on the same day unambiguous.

ambiguous.when: a row has more than one candidate partner

leg_id.note: Each leg uses its own pickup time; legs A and B of a pair do not share an identifier. To be confirmed with the TOBI test import (risk 4.3 of the v2.0 specification).

components.AlnumClientID: Client ID with every character outside A-Z, a-z, 0-9 removed (for companions, a trailing PCA is removed first)
components.HHMM: PUTime hours and minutes; seconds are dropped (two trips in the same minute collide)

collision_controls.detection: After exact-deduplication, group by generated Vendor ID; any count > 1 is a collision.
likely_causes: same client/date/pickup time for two distinct CLI trips
collision_controls.resolution: Correct source data or obtain a TOBI-approved additional alphanumeric discriminator. Never silently append a counter.

collision_controls.detection: After pairing and ID generation, group by generated Leg ID; any count > 1 is a collision.
likely_causes: same client/date/time/type and same A/B assignment
duplicate not exact because a non-key field differs
collision_controls.resolution: Review the pair and source data. Do not auto-renumber unless TOBI approves a discriminator.

collision_controls.detection: A reciprocal pair contains more than one A or more than one B.

validations.assertion: Every Vendor ID matches ^[A-Za-z0-9]+$ and is nonblank.
Every Leg ID matches ^[A-Za-z0-9]+$ and is nonblank.
Vendor ID is unique across the output after exact deduplication.
Leg ID is unique across the output after exact deduplication.
Companion IDs end in PCA or PCAA/PCAB as applicable and never include _ or -.
Reprocessing produces identical IDs and does not append companion suffixes twice.
Pairing assigns A to the earlier pickup and B to the later pickup within an identified reciprocal pair.
Ambiguous pairing and key collisions block ready-for-import status.

exception_severity_meaning.warning: row stays in Output; shown in the summary
exception_severity_meaning.error: row goes to Invalid Trips; export continues
exception_severity_meaning.blocking: Output is not produced until the source is corrected
